description: Show where each kind of data the person's goals need will come from, as one map. Call it once the person's sources are saved (save_data_sources) and before walking the connect queue. Returns one row per kind in the order setup fills them: products, current stock, sales history, purchase history, suppliers, costs, lead times, bills of materials for an account that makes products, then what items sell for (optional, never blocks setup). Each row has the chosen source it comes from and its route, where that source stands (connected, not connected, needs attention), a fallback, what Spark measured (status and count), gap = none of the chosen sources brings it, and one action: connect (start_integration_connect), link (a Foundations page), upload (create_import_session) or the person typing a few rows here. Lead with the summary, name the gaps plainly, and do one row's action at a time, starting with nextKind. Saying a source can bring a kind never marks it ready: statuses are measured. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential.
name: get_data_coverage
title: Data Coverage
